name: information-flow
description: Daily intake, weekly journal, and Markdown Cognition (Evidence/Belief/Principle, schema 1.1) in DigitalBrain. Private cognition stays out of this repo.

interface.shortDescription: Intake daily, journal weekly, retrieve cognition
interface.longDescription: Pulls Snipd, WeRead, and YouTube likes into weekly intake.md. Discussion starts from recent journals and old project echoes, not a week dump. Journal writes only after Jake says OK. Cognition (Evidence/Belief/Principle, schema_version 1.1) is a separate Markdown layer in DigitalBrain with a human gate; private cognition is not stored in this repo. Skill copies sync into DigitalBrain.
